recipe.visualDefinition: A soft-focus portrait of a blonde woman with blue-tipped hair, set against a vibrant pastel sky of pink, blue, and yellow clouds. The composition features a central figure looking downward, accented by a glittery heart around one eye and a sparkling, hand-written script title floating above.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject hair color echoing the blue tones of the sky
Glitter texture on the face mirroring the texture of the title lettering
Soft, hazy lighting blending the subject into the atmospheric background
Vertical alignment between the subject's head and the centered typography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up, centered horizontally, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, specifically the glitter heart detail around the eye.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the glitter title, moves down to the subject's face, and follows the hair down to the blue tips.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third of the frame is dominated by expansive, colorful cloud formations.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pink and peach tones in the clouds and skin.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Sky blue in the upper left and hair tips.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Magenta glitter for the title and eye detail.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value (bright) with medium saturation; colors are vibrant but soft, avoiding harsh blacks.
paletteRestrictions: No deep blacks or high-contrast shadows
Primary focus on cyan, magenta, and pale yellow

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with a slight upward tilt.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital 'L' features a large, expressive top loop and a sweeping tail that underlines the following letter.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single expressive script paired with a clean photographic background.
graphicDevices: Soft light leaks on the right edge

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the organic, hand-written feel of the original.
Maintains the specific material quality of the lettering.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A soft-focus portrait of a blonde woman with blue-dipped hair looking down, wearing a white t-shirt, with a glitter heart around her eye, set against a dreamy pink and blue pastel cloud sky.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a hand-written cursive title in the top center using a magenta glitter texture and a slight upward tilt.

verificationChecks: Does the sky contain a gradient of pink, blue, and yellow?
Is the glitter texture present on both the face and the text?
Is the hair color transition from blonde to blue smooth?
Is the overall image contrast low and dreamy?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue hair tips
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the blue hair tips match the sky blue tone.
Check that the glitter heart is centered over the eye area.
Verify the text has a grainy, sparkling texture rather than a flat color.
Confirm the background clouds look like a soft-focus watercolor painting.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a soft-focus pastel sky background with a centered portrait featuring a color-matched hair accent and a textured, hand-written script overlay.
